verdict.rationale: Intel Gaudi 3 has a software stack with documentation, so an interactive API reference is a fair question for this kind of product. The docs mention 'API references' and 'code samples' in general terms, but nothing shows an interactive explorer or runnable-in-browser examples. Probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec, no llms.txt and no markdown docs endpoint, so static references are only adjacent to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
